startTalents.name: 뇌신의 도끼
startTalents.description:

startTalents.description_en:
Quest (x10): Spending 100 Dream Shards grants +1 Crit Chance
Complete: ATTACK finisher sends 3 lightning strikes to nearby enemies, with each strike dealing {0} damage

startTalents.name: 해방된 야수
startTalents.description: 킨타로가 걸어다니는 동안, 쿠마는 킨타로가 타고 있을 때와 마찬가지로 연쇄 공격을 할 수 있으며, 총 +{0}%의 대미지를 줍니다.
startTalents.description_en: While Kintarō is on foot, Kuma can chain attacks the same way he does while Kintarō is riding him, dealing +{0}% damage in total

startTalents.name: 활력의 오라
startTalents.description: 킨타로가 쿠마를 타고 있는 동안, 그와 주변 모든 영웅들의 이동 속도가 {0}% 증가합니다.
startTalents.description_en: While Kintarō is riding Kuma, he and all nearby Heroes gain +{0}% MOVE SPEED

startTalents.name: 맹렬한 돌진
startTalents.description:
킨타로가 걸어갈 때, 쿠마를 이동시키면 표시된 방향으로 돌진하여 적중시킨 적에게 {0}% 파워 대미지를 줍니다.

startTalents.description_en:
When Kintarō is on foot, moving Kuma causes him to charge in the indicated direction, dealing {0}% POWER damage to enemies hit
This talent has a cooldown of 5 seconds

talents.name: 표적 물어뜯기

Each ATTACK that hits an enemy grants Kintarō and Kuma +{0}% ATTACK SPEED (up to +25%)

talents.name: 귀청을 찢는 듯한 울부짖음

킨타로가 공격을 막을 때마다 그의 주위에 숲의 정령이 나타납니다(최대 6).

Whenever Kintarō blocks an attack, a Forest Spirit appears around him (up to 6)

talents.description_en: While Kintarō is on foot, using POWER, SPECIAL or DEFENSE triggers an energy discharge between Kintarō and Kuma, dealing {0} damage to enemies passed through

+{0} 방어력 획득

Gain +{0}  ARMOR
